args.title: Incident summary: double charge on retry
args.body: Retry logic in retry.py did not carry the idempotency key across the second capture attempt, so a retried payment was processed as a new charge. Roughly 40 orders per day were affected, with customers being double-charged on retried transactions. The root cause is confirmed and reproduced in staging; the fix is to persist the idempotency key before the first capture, and it is up for review in PR #481.
